name: DXP Assistant
description: Integrates the DXP assistant scripts and provides it the required endpoints and information.
project_description: DXP Assistant wires an external Digital Experience Platform (DXP) assistant into a Drupal site. As shipped in this pre-release (1.0.0-alpha1), the module does one thing: it loads a remote assistant JavaScript from an admin-configured URL by injecting a <script src> tag into the HTML head of every page, but only for users who hold the 'access dxp assistant' permission. The script URL is set on a single admin configuration form and stored in plain config (dxp_assistant.configuration:script_url). Despite the project description mentioning 'endpoints and information', this release defines no HTTP data endpoints, no controllers, no services, no drupalSettings output, no declared JS libraries, and no API key / credential handling of any kind. It is an early work-in-progress release.
